notes.title: Update 1.2 Bug fixes and balance changes
notes.notes:
Time for another smaller update, but it hopefully has a larger impact on some of the builds in the game with some buffs to upgrades that did not feel impactful enough. The xp amount increase from upgraded minions should hopefully make it easier to come back in a round where the minions have become too many since if you manage to kill some of the large ones off you will level up quite quickly. 

[h1]Features/Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] New upgrade Holy Fire Count. Increase the targets damaged by Holy Fire by 1
[*] Increased the limit of active gold coins on the map from 256 to 512
[/list] 

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the xp gained from upgraded minions from 2 times the base amount to 3 times the base amount
[*] Holy Fire Heal upgrade heal chance increased from 15% to 25%
[*] Holy Fire Heal upgrade heal amount increased from 10 to 15
[*] Increased the Bear base health from 200 to 300
[*] Dash Unstoppable now grants unstoppable for a short duration after the Dash has ended as well
[*] Weapon Dash Unstoppable now grants unstoppable for a short duration after the Dash has ended as well
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed so Bodhmall cannot be used to unlock the No Healing achievement since her passive ability is a healing ability
[*] Bear can now pickup gold coins after getting the bear pickup upgrade
[*] Block ability effect is now in the correct place for the Monk character
[*] Lava pools no longer stays active after game over
[*] Fixed rendering issues on Pirate map and The Forge map
[*] Fixed a bug where some crowd control effects already active would not clear when becoming unstoppable from certain abilities
[/list]

notes.title: Full release and 1.0 update patch notes
notes.notes:
The full release of Sidestep Legends is here! In this post I will present the new things that have been added in the 1.0 update, future plans for the game and the detailed patch notes for the update.

Important note: This update includes some rearranges in the skill tree and therefore your skill tree will be reset. All your spent gold will be refunded. Just remember to level up the upgrades you want to have again when starting the game.

[h1]Summary of early access updates[/h1]
For those of you who only played one of the earlier versions during early access let's start with a summary of what has been added in the previous updates during early access. If you have been keeping up with the updates during early access you can skip this part. The first updates improved the collision handling of the player and the path finding for the boss. From my observations from players playing the game these two were the most important things to address first. 

The next update added the character Grendel's Mother. She has the unique passive that she can use her basic attack while moving. This was something requested by several people that were more used to playing more relaxed games in the genre. While I did not want to change the game completely and add attacking while moving to all characters, giving this as a passive to one character felt like a good compromise.

The next big update was the minion update. It was divided in two updates each adding two new minion types. Each minion type has their own strength compared to the basic minion. The earth minion has more health, the fire minion deals more damage, the ice minion slows the player and the air minion is faster.

After the minion update it came the map rework update. In this four new hostile abilities were introduced. Two new crowd control abilities, the ice projectile which slows the player if hit and the whirlwind which stuns the player if hit. Each crowd control ability is only present on one map, the ice projectile on Asag's Forest, the root projectile on Pirate Island and the whirlwind on The Forge. So the crowd controls get harder with each map. Two new hostile damage abilities were also added in this update, the arcane spin and the galaxy orb. Arcane spin is mostly on The Forge and Galaxy Orb mostly on Pirate Island. To help the player survive these new challenges two new healing abilities were added, Healing Circle and Healing Potion. 

This update also came with a rework of the curse upgrade. It is now divided into four different upgrades allowing for more granular control of the difficulty. One for how fast minions spawns, one for how much damage minions do, one for how many hostile abilities spawn and one for how much damage hostile abilities do. All of them are found in the skill tree.

In the last update during early access I added an important part of games in this genre, the reroll, banish and lock options for upgrades. They can be unlocked in the skill tree and you can unlock a lot of them as long as you have the gold to really help you get to that specific build you have in mind. 

This was a summary of the updates during early access, there were some more bug fixes, balance changes and minor features added that you can read about in the past patch notes posts.

[h1]New things in the 1.0 update[/h1]
So let's get to what is new in this update. As you may have seen in the preview image of this post this update introduces three new characters. Each of them has a new ability that they start with and a new passive ability. 

Abaddon has the passive Aspect Of The Demon which makes him completely immune to crowd control effects, but whenever he gets hit by a crowd control ability his healing is reduced by 50% for 10 seconds. This hero should hopefully help the ones of you that get too frustrated by the crowd control effects, but you still have to be careful about taking damage since it might not be so easy to heal yourself up again. He starts with the new ability Firestorm which when active summons a circle of fire around the player which damages all minions inside it. 

Bodhmall starts with the new ability Bear and Healing Circle. Bear gives you a bear pet that attacks enemies and can be targeted by hostile abilities and enemies. Her passive is Beastmastery which heals her or the bear depending on who has the lowest health whenever she uses an ability or the bear attacks.

Monk has the passive Protective Spirit which makes it so you cannot lose more than 10% of your max health form a single attack or ability. He starts with the new ability Holy Fire which when active damages a nearby enemy every time he takes damage. Look for a couple of new upgrades that lowers your max health but increases a lot of other stats with this hero.

New map Desert. This map is the hardest of the maps and includes all the different hostile abilities and has a higher minion spawn rate and higher ability spawn count.

The next new feature is achievements. There are 100 achievements. Some are simpler such as unlocking a certain ability and some more challenging such as surviving for a certain time or clearing a map with some restriction. Worth noting is that I had plans for about double the amount of achievements but Steam does not let me add more until "your title reaches our confidence metric". Which is a bit of a shame, of course if the game at some point has sold enough copies to reach this confidence metric I will add the additional achievements. 

The final new feature in this update is Steam Leaderboards. I came up with three areas I thought would be fun to compete with other on, minion kills, curse level and overtime. Minion kills is just the number of minions you kill during a game. Curse level is the combined curse level from the four curse upgrades in the skill tree. When you complete the 20 waves on a map your combined curse level will be added to the leaderboard. Overtime is the time you survive on the Death Wave. Each of these categories have their own leaderboard for all four maps, so in total there are 12 leaderboards to compete on.

There are also some balance updates, bug fixes, a few new combo upgrades as well as upgrades for all the new abilities. You can read all the details about those in the full patch notes at the end of this post.

[h1]Future plans for Sidestep Legends[/h1]
So now when the game is out of early access, what is next? With this update I feel like I have added pretty much all the things I really wanted to add to the game. Of course with a game like this there are endless new things you could add and I do have some ideas for new abilities that I did not get to. However unfortunately so far the game has not sold nearly well enough to be able to sustain me as a full time indie developer. So in order to be able to keep doing that I need to move on to new projects. 

I will of course make new updates fixing any bugs that appear and I have a few more combo upgrades that I want to add that I did not have time for in this update. So you can expect one or two updates in the coming month with those. But there will probably not be any more significant content added to the game. Maybe I might add some more new combo upgrades every once in a while or even a new ability if I feel the need to take a small break from other projects. Especially if you leave suggestions in the Steam discussion boards or on the Discord server, for example ideas about fun combo upgrades for any of the ability combinations that don't have any combo upgrade yet. That would greatly increase the chance that I add some new things since then it would feel worth it even if the sales aren't enough.

[h2]New features[/h2]

[*] New combo upgrade Holy Fire Heal. Gain 15% chance to heal for 10 health each time you deal damage with Holy Fire

[*] New ability Bear. Summon a bear that can attack enemies and get targeted by hostile abilities and enemy units

[*] New combo upgrade Bear Block. Whenever the player is invulnerable, the bear also gets the same effect

[*] New passive Protective Spirit. You cannot lose more than 10% max health due to damage from a single attack or spell

[*] Achievements. 100 achievements to unlock. See https://steamcommunity.com/stats/2077590/achievements/ for a full list

[h2]Balance changes[/h2]

notes.title: Full release date announcement!
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce that the full version of Sidestep Legends will release on April 13th 2023. With the full release the price of the game will be increased to match the amount of content that has been added and the new content that will be coming in the 1.0 update on the release day. So if you or any you know have been thinking about buying the game but haven't gotten to it yet, now is a very good time to do so. The price will be increased from the current $2.99 to $4.99 or your regional equivalent. 

So what is coming in the 1.0 update? Let me tell you. There will be three new characters to unlock and play, each with a new starting ability (that can also be picked up by other characters in a level up upgrade). There will also be a new map and a bunch of new combo upgrades, both with the new abilities but also some for the already existing abilities. The update will also add achievements to the game as well as leaderboards. So you can compete globally or against your friends and show who is the best sidestepper. 

Here is a teaser with two of the new characters that comes in the update

notes.title: Update 0.5.7 Reroll, Banish, Lock, Area and Revive
notes.notes:
This update adds a much needed feature for these types of games. The ability to steer the randomness a bit with the help of Reroll, Banish and Lock. If you have played other games in this genre you probably recognize them, but in short here is how they work. You can use them when levelling up. Reroll will replace the upgrades options with new ones. With Banish you can remove an upgrade entirely from the pool of this run and it will be replaced with another one. Lock can be used on an upgrade option to keep it for the next level up, useful in the case where you get offered more than one upgrade that you would want to pick.

In order to get charges of Reroll, Banish and Lock you need to unlock them in the skill tree.

This update also introduces two new passive upgrades, Ability Area and Revive. You can read about them in the detailed as well as some balance changes and bug fixes in the full patch notes below.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620715/7daa09fdcbd4db840a6cdb2bfb55a6e8b9bb8057.png[/img]

[h1]Features/Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Ability Area upgrade, both in game and in the skill tree. It increases the area of abilities that covers an area
[*] Added Revive upgrade, both in game and in the skill tree. In the case of taking fatal damage a revive is consumed instead and you will be brought back to full health
[*] Added the Reroll upgrade to the skill tree. A reroll can be used to get new choices of upgrades when levelling up 
[*] Added the Banish upgrade to the skill tree. A banish can be used to block an upgrade from appearing for the rest of the round
[*] Added the Lock upgrade to the skill tree. A lock can be used to keep an upgrade option to the next level up
[*] Added support to switch tips on pause screen with controller
[*] Added support to swap the position of abilities with the controller on the pause screen
[*] When using Blink and aiming with the mouse (moba controls, wasd controls) you will now teleport to the position of the mouse cursor if the distance between the cursor and the player is within the range of the Blink ability
[*] When using throwing a Healing Potion and aiming with the mouse (moba controls, wasd controls) it will now land at the position of the mouse cursor if the distance between the cursor and the player is within the range of Healing Pot ability
[*] Healing Pot ability range is now affected by the Ability Range upgrade.

[/list]

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Stealth from the Dash Stealth upgrade will now apply effects from the Stealth Armor upgrade
[*] Stealth from the Dash Stealth upgrade will now apply effects from the Stealth Sprint upgrade
[*] Stealth from the Chanel Heal Stealth upgrade will now apply effects from the Stealth Armor upgrade
[*] Stealth from the Chanel Heal Stealth upgrade will now apply effects from the Stealth Sprint upgrade
[/list]


[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing the Flame Walk heal upgrade to show the wrong description text sometimes
[*] Fixed a bug causing stealth effects from other sources than the Stealth ability to show up on the Stealth ability's duration
[*] Added a buff indicator for the Channel Heal Armor upgrade 
[*] Fixed a bug where the character could end up gliding against walls or other map elements after releasing the movement controls
[*] Fixed a bug causing abilities bound to the A button to be activated after picking the boss upgrade
[*] Fixed postion of level up text for super ultrawide screens
[*] Fixed a game freeze bug that could happen in rare cases when the boss should spawn
[*] Fixed a bug causing whirlwinds to deal way too much damage while the player is immune to crowd control effects
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.5.6 New hostile abilities!
notes.notes:
Time for a new update! This update adds some more variation for the hostile abilities in the waves and also some hostile ability variation on the different maps. It also comes with a rebalance of the difficulty. The game should now hopefully feel much less frustrating and not be too hard for new players. 

The curse upgrade has also been reworked and split into different categories so you through the skill tree can increase the difficulty with for different upgrades for anyone that finds the game too easy after the difficulty adjustments. 

Also two new abilities that can be unlocked, both healing abilities to help you keep the health up during the tough waves. Full details of the updates is in the patch notes below. 

Since this update rearranges the skill tree a bit it will be automatically refunded for you when you start the game. So don't forget to head into the skill tree and pick the upgrades you want in there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620715/5f92e442d3a24c49aeedfe007c96c482f2096321.png[/img]

[h1]Features/Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new hostile ability Arcane Spin that will spawn in some waves. It spins around the spawn position and deals damage if hit
[*] Added new hostile ability Ice Projectile that will spawn in some waves. It deals damage and slows the player if hit
[*] Added new hostile ability Whirlwind that will spawn in some waves. It deals damage and stuns the player if hit
[*] Added new hostile ability Galaxy Orb that will spawn in some waves. It grows larger the longer it travels and deals damage based on the size if hit
[*] Remade a lot of the waves and some of them are now different on the different maps
[*] Darkened the colour of the sand on the Pirate Map to make spells more visible on top of it
[*] Curse in skill tree has been reworked and split into 4 different "upgrades". One for increasing minion spawns, one for increasing the number of abilities spawned, one for increasing the hostile ability damage and one for increasing minion damage
[*] New ability Healing Circle, Place a circle of healing on the ground which heals you and any allies in it for 20 health after 3 seconds
[*] New ability Healing Potion, Throw a Potion of healing on the ground which grows over time for up to 2 seconds and heals for up to 10 health depending on the size when you walk into it

[/list]

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Dragon Resilience passive now unlocks healing upgrades for the abilities that have healing upgrades
[*] Removed Curse from in game upgrades
[*] Reduced minion spawn rate 
[*] Reduced the max number of abilities that can spawn at the same time on Asag's Forest
[*] Increased the max number of abilities that can spawn at the same time on The Forge
[/list]


[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing the light from flamestrikes to flicker when more than one flamestrike was active at the same time
[*] Fixed a bug where the sprint after stealth upgrade did not always apply the corrent movement speed multiplier
[*] Fixed a bug where the sprint after stealth upgrade could override the sprint ability's duration
[*] Fixed a bug where block did not remove slow effects when used
[*] Fixed a bug where dash when upgraded with invulnerability did not remove slow effects when used
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.5.5 Minion update part 2
notes.notes:
So last patch while making the combat a more interesting made it a bit too hard to get going in certain cases. There were very small margins that decided if you would have a really good run or simply not having a chance to survive at all getting overrun by the number of minions. This patch which is part 2 of the minion update will fix that mainly by having the stronger minion types start spawning of certain waves instead of being able to spawn from the start. There are also some changes that increases the ability to regain health. Additionally two new minion types have been added. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620715/3ebf1227ca9d2fdfe206d9e6cd6ac63b6fc16ff3.png[/img]

[h1]Features/Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added meat as a possible drop from Vases. Picking up meat will heal you for 50 health
[*] Added a new minion type, ice minion. It slows you when you get attacked by it and starts spawning on wave 11
[*] Added a new minion type, air minion. It moves much faster than the other minions and starts spawning on wave 15
[*] Collision against prison walls now use the same collision handing as against the static terrain
[*] Added keyboard hotkeys for selecting upgrades, the number keys 1,2,3 and 4 will select the corresponding upgrade from the top of the list 
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Earth minions do no longer spawn before wave 3
[*] Fire minions do no longer spawn before wave 7
[*] Reduced the attack range of the fire minion to the same range as the basic minion
[*] Increased the attack damage of the fire minion from 5 to 15
[*] Reduced the attack damage of the earth minion from 10 to 5
[*] Reduced the attack damage of the basic minion from 5 to 3
[*] Increased the healing from the weapon dash heal upgrade for level 2 from 4 to 5 and for level 3 from 5 to 7
[*] Xp dropped from the large minions is now double the amount of the normal ones
[*] Increased the base health regen of Lilith from 1 per 5 seconds to 3 per 5 seconds
[*] Increased the base health regen of Thor from 4 per 5 seconds to 6 per 5 seconds
[*] Increased the base health regen of The Ghostly Nun from 1 per 5 seconds to 3 per 5 seconds
[*] Increased the base health regen of Hrungnir from 1 per 5 seconds to 3 per 5 seconds
[*] Increased the base health regen of Grendel's Mother from 1 per 5 seconds to 3 per 5 seconds
[/list]


[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that happened sometimes when alt tabbing out or into the game
[*] Fixed a crash that happened sometimes when heading to play after resetting the skill tree
[*] Fixed a bug where the stats in the play scene did not update after buying upgrades in the skill tree
[*] Fixed a bug where one of the fonts would end up disappearing sometimes when playing as Grendel's Mother
[*] Fixed a bug causing more than one chest to appear after a challenge that could end up causing a crash
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.5.4 New minions and new Combo upgrades!
notes.notes:
This update is the first part in making the minions and fighting against them more interesting. Two new minion types have been added and the minion upgrade behaviour has been clarified a bit. Additionally there are some balance changes and some new combo upgrades for some of the abilities that did not get any in the last update. Lastly this update includes a crash handler that saves a minidump of the game state in the case of a crash. So if you encounter a crash, have a look in the Steam discussion board for a pinned post about how to send me a crash report so I can fix whatever was causing the crash as soon as possible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620715/a76a7ecc3759316982c5e475173641e38a7befec.png[/img]

[h1]Features/Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] New upgrade Weapon Throw Armor, for each enemy hit by Weapon Throw, gain a stack of Hardened Skin lasting for 6 seconds increasing the armor by 5, refreshing when new stacks are applied, and stacking up to 10 times
[*] New upgrade Weapon Swing Armor, for each enemy hit by Weapon Swing, gain a stack of Hardened Skin lasting for 6 seconds increasing the armor by 5, refreshing when new stacks are applied, and stacking up to 10 times
[*] New upgrade Hardened Shield Damage, deal damage equal to the damage blocked by Hardened Shield in a small area around you
[*] New upgrade Flame Walk Lava Pool Duration, increase the duration of Lava Pools by 15%
[*] New upgrade Flame Walk Armor, gain 50 armor while standing in a Flame Walk lava pool
[*] New upgrade Flame Walk Heal, heal for 4 health per second while standing in a Flame Walk lava pool
[*] New upgrade Weapon Dash Damage Stacks, Weapon Dash now grants a stack of Sharpened Blade lasting for 6 seconds increasing the damage of Weapon Dash by 10, refreshing when new stacks are applied, and stacking indefinitely
[*] New upgrade Weapon Dash Unstoppable, become Unstoppable during Weapon Dash
[*] Added a progress bar above minions showing how close they are to potentially upgrade
[*] Added a crash handler to the game, so if you encounter a crash check the pinned post on the steam forums on how to send me a crash report
[*] Added a new minion type, earth minion. It does more damage and has more health than the basic minion
[*] Added a new minion type, fire minion. It has longer attack range than the basic minion

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]

notes.title: Update 0.5.3 New character Grendel's Mother!
notes.notes:
This update includes a new character called Grendel's Mother. She has a passive ability that let's her attack while moving, which is something a few of you have asked for in the Steam discussion forum. She also comes with a new ability (that of course all the other characters can unlock in a run as well) called Bloodlust. It increases the basic attack speed when active which fits well with Grendel's Mother's ability to attack while moving. You can see a short gif of her with the Bloodlust ability active here below. This update also comes with a bunch of new combo upgrades, upgrades that unlock if you have unlocked two specific abilities. So take a look at those and see if you can come up with some exciting new builds with them. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620715/019be753845447281defead5c8d97ac580cedacb.gif[/img]
